structural.note: Redundancy: nigella-sativa ('nigella sativa seed') is the Latin binomial of nigella-seed (kalonji/black cumin) — identical aliases, freshness, tags. nigella-seed already carries 'nigella sativa' as an alias (Tier-1). Fold the binomial item into the common-name canonical.

Redundancy: 'oriental poppy seed' is spurious (oriental poppy is ornamental, not a culinary seed) and duplicates poppy-seed (same khus-khus/poppy-seeds aliases + freshness). poppy-seed is the canonical; white-poppy-seed already exists as the real culinary split.

Redundancy: two egusi entries — 'egusi melon seed' (id egusi, child of melon-seed, no aliases) and standalone 'egusi seed' (id egusi-seed, better aliases). Keep the recognized standalone name egusi-seed; fold the duplicate in.
After folding the egusi duplicate, re-home the surviving egusi-seed under melon-seed (egusi is ground melon seed), preserving the parentage the dropped duplicate had.

Freshness bug: Refrigerated [30,60] was SHORTER than Pantry [365,730] for a dry seed (the 30-60 window belongs to fresh lotus seed only). Refrigerated should be >= Pantry; added a Frozen window to match dry-seed modeling.

cleanups.note: Remove 'Nut-Free' — mixed nuts contain tree nuts and usually peanuts; they are a top allergen and must not claim Nut-Free.
Mixed nuts carry tree-nut and (typically) peanut allergens; was empty. Agrees with the de-Nut-Free dietary change.

cleanups.name: mixed nuts
cleanups.note: Display was the mangled 'mixed nuts nut'; correct to 'mixed nuts'.
Remove 'Nut-Free' — the generic 'nut' parent is by definition not nut-free.

'ground nut' is the British/African word for peanut, not the generic nut — it caused a groundnut collision. peanut already carries 'ground nut'/'groundnut'/'groundnuts' aliases (Tier-1), so removing here resolves it cleanly.
Data error: white chia (a chia color morph) is not white poppy seed (khus-khus). The standalone white-poppy-seed item now exists, so drop this mis-resolving alias.
Remove the cross 'egusi' alias so watermelon-seed (snack kernel) doesn't mis-resolve into egusi-seed (ground gourd-seed stew base); keep them culinarily distinct.
